declarations.name: AppConfig
declarations.doc: The project configuration (`appConfig` kind): connections and global services.

declarations.name: AppEvent
declarations.doc: The base of the `event` kind: a name and a JSON form, so another window or worker can publish it.

members.name: build
members.doc: Builds the screen's props from the url parameters (`state.arg('id')`).

members.name: loggedIn
members.doc: The screen asks for a session; without it, go to `loggedIn`.

members.name: acl
members.doc: The screen asks for roles, permissions or guards; without them, go to `denied`.

declarations.name: Bridge
declarations.doc: What a host page gives a mounted app to reach its service: the frames go out with `send` and come back to `onMessage`'s callback (the host forwards them, with its token).

declarations.name: BridgeTransport

members.name: base
members.doc: What a request's path is appended to: the API's url (`Http`), `/` for a socket's frames.

members.name: exchange
members.doc: One request and its answer (the body parsed as JSON when it is JSON); a network failure throws HttpError(0).

members.name: listen
members.doc: Calls `on` with the data of every event `topic` the server pushes; gives back the function that stops.

declarations.doc: The host's bridge as the transport of every repository of a mounted app (ADR-synapsis-0009).

declarations.name: Cache
declarations.doc: `@get(cache = true, ttl = Duration(minutes = 10))`: a response kept `ttl` milliseconds under `key`.

declarations.name: ComponentConfig
declarations.doc: The configuration of one component (`config` kind): its own connections and services.

declarations.name: Connection
declarations.doc: Something the app opens at start; `connectionName` tells two of a kind apart (`''` is the default one).

declarations.name: Decode
declarations.doc: How a response body becomes the value a method returns.

declarations.name: Fragment
declarations.doc: Lets you group elements without a wrapper node.

declarations.name: Frames

members.name: receive
members.doc: A frame that arrived.

members.name: resubscribe
members.doc: Every topic listened to, sent again (after a reconnection).

members.name: fail
members.doc: The requests in flight fail like a network failure (the repository's retries cover them).

declarations.doc: Requests and subscriptions over something that carries frames (a socket, a bridge).

declarations.name: Global

members.name: register
members.doc: Registers this object in the injector under its own class (`register(Self, () => this)`).

declarations.doc: A service that lives for the whole app (SessionManager, Events...): listed in `globals`, started by Synapsis.

declarations.name: Guard
declarations.doc: A custom access check (`guard` kind): `canActivate()` says whether the caller may go on.

declarations.name: Host
declarations.doc: What the host gives: its bridge to the service, and the first path of the app's router.

declarations.name: HttpError

declarations.name: HttpInterceptor

members.name: timeout

declarations.name: MAX_DIGITS
declarations.doc: The most digits an exact number of an answer has, written without an exponent (the backend's limit).

members.name: purge
members.doc: Forgets `key` and every key that starts with `key|` (the key plus its arguments).

declarations.doc: `NetworkManager()` in globals: whether the browser is online.

declarations.name: NotFound
declarations.doc: A row or a value that is not there (a `find`, a `<method>AsLocal()` never answered).

declarations.name: Providers

declarations.name: ReactElement

declarations.name: ReactNode
declarations.doc: Represents all of the things React can render.

declarations.name: Repository

members.name: target
members.doc: The url of `path` under the repository's and the connection's, with `:name` replaced, and the query.

members.name: send
members.doc: One request: the cache first (when asked), then fetch with retries; throws HttpError.

members.name: stream
members.doc: `@on("topic")` on a method that returns `Stream<T>`: what the server pushes on that topic, read by `decode`.

members.name: attempt
members.doc: Turns a thrown AppError into a value: `attempt(() => send(...), Ok, (e) => Err(new X({ message: e.message })))`.

members.name: result
members.doc: A `Result` method: `Ok` of what `call` answers, or `Err(err(error))` when it throws an AppError.

members.name: purgeCache
members.doc: Forgets the cached responses of `key` (`purge<Method>()` calls it).

declarations.doc: The base of the `repository` kind.

members.name: match
members.doc: One value from both sides: `result.match((e) => ..., (v) => ...)`, error first as in the mobile platform.

members.name: retry
members.doc: Extra attempts after a transient failure (GET, PUT and DELETE retry twice by themselves).

members.name: emit
members.doc: Replaces the state and tells every subscriber (a screen re-renders).

members.name: stateTurn
members.doc: A new call of an asynchronous state method (`@state`): its turn. Only the latest call's answer is emitted.

members.name: close

members.name: headers

members.name: timeout

declarations.name: buildRouter
declarations.doc: A router with every screen of the app; `initial` is the first path (tests, and a mounted app: a memory router).

declarations.name: el
declarations.doc: `el('div', props, ...children)`: createElement with the children in the props or after them.

declarations.name: exactText
declarations.doc: The text of an exact number of a JSON answer, checked: what `BigInt(...)` or the dialect's decimal reads.

declarations.name: fragment
declarations.doc: Several elements without a wrapper.

declarations.name: goBack
declarations.doc: Back one page.

declarations.name: goTo
declarations.doc: Goes to a screen: goTo(CharacterDetailScreen, { id: character.id }).

declarations.name: inject
declarations.doc: The object registered for `cls`.

declarations.name: mountApp
declarations.doc: Mounts `app` in `element`; gives back the function that unmounts it.

declarations.name: okOf
declarations.doc: `expect(result).toEqual(isOkWith(x))` helpers: the value of an Ok, or the error of an Err.

declarations.name: pathTo
declarations.doc: The path of a screen with its parameters: pathTo(CharacterDetailScreen, { id: 3 }) → '/characters/3'.

declarations.name: pushTo
declarations.doc: The same as goTo (the web has one history stack); kept so mobile code reads the same.

declarations.name: register
declarations.doc: Registers `cls`: `singleton` (default) builds it once; `{ singleton: false }` builds it on every `inject`.

declarations.name: renderScreen
declarations.doc: Renders a screen inside a memory router (its route and the others of `routes`).

declarations.name: replace
declarations.doc: Puts `instance` in place of whatever `cls` would build (tests: a fake, a mock).

declarations.name: resetInjector
declarations.doc: Forgets everything (tests).

declarations.name: statefulOf
declarations.doc: The component of a stateful view.

declarations.name: statelessOf
declarations.doc: The component of a stateless view: `createElement(statelessOf(Cls), props)`.

declarations.name: statesOf
declarations.doc: Every state a manager emits while `act` runs (the `@states` tests).

declarations.name: useCallback
declarations.doc: `useCallback` will return a memoized version of the callback that only changes if one of the `inputs` has changed.

declarations.name: useEffect
declarations.doc: Accepts a function that contains imperative, possibly effectful code.

declarations.name: useEvent
declarations.doc: The last event of class `cls` the component saw (`null` before the first): re-renders on every event.

declarations.name: useManager
declarations.doc: The provided manager of class `cls` (the screen's, or an ancestor screen's).

declarations.name: useManagerState
declarations.doc: The state of a manager held elsewhere (a stateful's field, a test).

declarations.name: useMemo
declarations.doc: `useMemo` will only recompute the memoized value when one of the `deps` has changed.

declarations.name: useRef
declarations.doc: `useRef` returns a mutable ref object whose `.current` property is initialized to the passed argument (`initialValue`). The returned object will persist for the full lifetime of the component.

declarations.name: useState
declarations.doc: Returns a stateful value, and a function to update it.

declarations.name: useStateOf
declarations.doc: The current state of the provided manager whose state is of class `cls`; re-renders when it changes.

declarations.name: verify
declarations.doc: How many times a mocked method ran: verify(repo.getPage).called(1).

declarations.name: when
declarations.doc: Prepares a mocked method: when(repo.getPage).thenReturn(Ok(page)) — async methods resolve with it.

declarations.name: wire
declarations.doc: `JSON.stringify`'s replacer of a request body: a model as its `toJson()` (its JSON names, its exact fields as texts), a `bigint` as its text.
